title: GitHub's Copilot command-line tool can now find AI models that a developer runs on their own computer.
key_facts: From CLI version 1.0.94-0, the /model command discovers supported models from a running local Ollama instance.
Discovery does not add a model automatically; the developer chooses and confirms it.
Ollama and the model must already be installed; the flow installs neither.
Models must support tool calling and streaming.
Choosing a local model does not turn on offline mode or disable GitHub telemetry.
GitHub also announces intelligent routing with local models, with availability to follow.
quote_evidence: Starting in CLI version 1.0.94-0, use /model to discover supported models from a running local Ollama instance, alongside your configured models and cloud models provided by GitHub Copilot.
Choosing a local model doesn't turn on offline mode or disable GitHub telemetry.
why_it_matters_hint: Developers can run a model on their own machine from inside the same tool, which can keep code on the device when the model is local.
